_comment: Ground cover for scenes/levels/vale.tscn, read by Grass.rebuild(). Lattice radius/cell size live on the Grass node; this file holds the wind and the layers. density is instances per square metre on ideal ground (before Grass.density_at and the multipliers below); max_per_cell caps a cell's MultiMesh; scale is uniform, height the blade height in metres (clump only); patch_min/patch_frequency is low-frequency noise that leaves bare patches (1.0 = none); hollow boosts density in cells below their surroundings (negative on knolls); cluster thickens within radius of the Forest's trees and falls to `outside` beyond radius+falloff; fade is [start, end] metres over which the shader sinks the piece into the ground; far_fraction is the share still drawn at the lattice edge; align tilts toward the ground normal (0 upright, 1 flat). Ashen, cold-morning palette: grey-green roots, straw tips, no saturated green.
